eutc_token.description: cw20 address of EUTC; the deployer registers csm-core as minter.

oracle.description: Feeder oracle adapter (fallback / override). Mints fail closed until wired when `oracle_mode` is `AdapterOnly`.

oracle_mode.description: Price-source selection; defaults to `ConsensusPrimary` (chain oracle ballot rates via the terra wasmbinding).

params.description: Defaults to the spec values when omitted.

reserve.description: Secondary reserve contract receiving all fees.

OracleMode.description: Price-source selection. `ConsensusPrimary` consumes the chain oracle's slashing-backed ballot rates via the terra wasmbinding (`ExchangeRates` custom query) and falls back to the adapter contract on failure; `AdapterOnly` uses only the feeder adapter (used by tests and for quotes outside the ballot denom set).

Params.description: Protocol parameters. Fee/cap values are in basis points (1.5% = 150).

daily_mint_cap_bps.description: Maximum new supply mintable per day, per collateral (20% = 2000). Bounds same-day mint→dump velocity.

daily_redeem_cap_bps.description: Maximum share of total EUTC supply redeemable per day (10% = 1000).

flash_fee_bps.description: Extra fee applied when redeeming EUTC minted to the sender within `flash_fee_window_blocks` (anti wash mint→dump loop).

max_dynamic_spread_bps.description: Dynamic redeem-spread headroom: up to this many bps are added to the redeem fee linearly as the daily window fills (0..=10_000 bps of utilization → 0..=max_dynamic_spread_bps added).

min_daily_mint_floor.description: Absolute floor on the daily mint allowance per collateral, in collateral micro-units. The percentage cap is relative to circulating supply, which is zero at protocol genesis — without this floor the first mints would be impossible (cap = supply × 0). Bootstrap-only in practice: the percentage cap overtakes it once supply grows.

min_primary_ratio_bps.description: Mints revert while aggregate primary collateral ratio is below this (95% = 9_500). The solvency governor (anti-dump L3). The floor must sit BELOW the steady-state ratio: the 1.5% mint fee skims the EURC ratio to ~98.5% by design (the 0.5% USDC premium lifts that leg to ~104%), so a 100% floor would halt all normal operation. 95% only trips on abnormal drain — extraction beyond fees approaching 4% of backing.

mint_fee_bps.description: Fee taken in the collateral used, on mint.

oracle_min_interval_secs.description: Minimum seconds between oracle price updates (spec: 30s refresh).

oracle_stale_secs.description: Price older than this is treated as stale; mints fail closed.

per_addr_redeem_cap_bps.description: Per-address share of supply redeemable per day (1% = 100). Bounds one whale's share of the daily window.

rebalance_threshold_bps.description: USDC/EURC value differential triggering reserve rebalancing (5% = 500). RESERVED, not yet enforced (see ARCHITECTURE §5).

redeem_fee_bps.description: Fee taken in the collateral withdrawn, on redemption.

usdc_premium_bps.description: USDC mint premium protecting against EUR/USD moves and DEX spread.
